test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following monsoon is responsible for torrential rainfall over the Tamil Nadu coast, southern Andhra Pradesh, southeast Karnataka and southeast Kerala during October and November?
solution:
The correct answer is __**North- east monsoon.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **North-east monsoon-**

 
 
• Generally, across the world, **monsoons** are experienced in **tropical** areas roughly between 20° N and 20° S.
 
• The climate of India is described as the **‘monsoon’ type.**
 
• In Asia, this type of climate is found mainly in the **south** and the **southeast**.
 
• Northeast monsoon occurs from **October to December**.
 
• It is a comparatively small-scale monsoon, which is confined to the **Southern peninsula.**
 
• It is called the **winter monsoon.**
 
• Rainfall is experienced in the southern part of India, mainly in **Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu** during this period.
 
• **Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand** experience precipitation in the form of rainfall or **snowfall** during the northeast monsoon.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **South-west monsoon- **

 
 
• The Southwest monsoon season is also called the **rainy season.**
 
• The South-west monsoon comes in from **June to September.**
 
• About **75%** of the country’s annual rainfall is received from the Southwest monsoon between **June and September.**
 
• This southwest monsoon is caused by an intense **low-pressure system** forming over the **Tibetan Plateau** as a result of intense heating during the **summer season.**
 
• Southeast trade winds cross the equator and enter the **Bay of Bengal and the Arabian Sea,** only to become entangled in the air circulation over India
